title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-04-11
source: Partial Set 3; 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips-Recorded by Bear (Reel # 4 Only); 1st Generation Cassettes(TDK SA-X 100's) Transferred By Dick Latvala; (Master Reel Playback on a Technics 1506 Reel 2 Reel-Tascam 122 MK111 Cassette Deck No Dolby); Analog to Digital Transfer (Cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon-Sony PCM-R500 DAT @ 44.1KHz by Jim Wise); Zero Gen DAT play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Out @ 16/44.1kHz-Digital Audio Labs Card deluxe-WAV @ 16/44.1KHz; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-Mastering & Processing (iZotope Ozone 6)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard snippet with a superb Love Light, but the rest of the 1970 show is missing.
ai_review.review: The short excerpt captures crystal‑clear soundboard quality and a high‑energy band performance, highlighted by Jerry Garcia’s fiery feedback solo during the Love Light jam. Reviewers rave about the audio fidelity, yet all express frustration that only ~30 minutes are available and the remainder of the concert—including the promised Dark Star > St. Stephen—was never released.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers praise the audio clarity and band inspiration, especially Jerry’s solo, while consistently lamenting the missing bulk of the show; this yields a strong musical rating offset by the incomplete recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear sound with no reported distortion or drop‑outs; reviewers note the snippet sounds great despite its brevity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a ~30‑minute segment is present, so overall set flow can’t be judged; the excerpt feels tight and energetic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia delivers an inspired feedback solo around the 18:00 mark of the Love Light jam.
